title: Other signs.
officialText:
Signage indicating special accessibility provisions shall be provided at fixed facilities and stations, signage must
be provided in accordance with Sections E109.2.2 through E109.2.2.3.
SECTION BC E108
RESERVED
SECTION BC E109
